race.comment: FRIAR'S LEGACY (3) missed by 2.2L last time out at Belmont and not comes across to Kalgoorlie with some good form under his belt. He's knocking on the door of another win and looks to have found the right race this time around. Can get back to winning ways. ACROSS GENERATIONS (8) was solid first-up in an easier race at Pinjarra, but the rating stacks up as he drops a stack of weight. Out to this trip is no issue and if he gets a touch of luck in running, he won't be far away. RIVERCREST MAGIC (13) hasn't fallen away after winning four starts ago, holding his form, including a 1.2L defeat last start. That effort stacks up here and she's not to be discounted here in a suitable event. FIVE DOWN (7) won't be far away. NORTHERN IVY (12) is next best.
